data.name: FlatLabel1.Text
data.value: Create a Windows System Restore point before making changes. Windows may be unable to create one if System Protection is disabled or a recent point already exists. We reccomend to make a Registry Backup. We are not responsible of damage to your machine. This may not be the best way to backup registry But if you have no clue how to do it This is a good chance for you to save your life.
